changelog:
- Initial release of glassdoor-salary-data skill.
- Resolve company names to Glassdoor employer IDs.
- Retrieve employer profiles with ratings, CEO approval, awards, and key company info.
- Access up to three detailed employee reviews, with pros, cons, advice, and employer responses.
- Pull salary percentiles (P10-P90, base and total pay) by job title, with support for paging.
- Four endpoints provided with structured JSON output; each call costs 1 API credit.
display_name: Glassdoor Salary Data API - Employer Profiles, Salaries, Reviews
summary: Resolve a company name to a Glassdoor employer id, then pull the employer profile with ratings and CEO approval, up to three full reviews, and salary percentiles by job title. 4 endpoints, 1 credit each, structured JSON.
